  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - MAY/JUNE 2023  
  SUBJECT: MIE 1071-PHY/MIE 1071-B/MME 1051-B - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING  
  BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING [MIE 1071-PHY]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          Two boilers are used to deliver steam into a common pipeline. The pressure in the  
  boilers and in the common pipeline is 10 bar. Boiler-1 generates dry steam and the  
  temperature of steam in the common pipeline is 200°C. If boiler-1 supplies 2kg of steam (4)  
  as compared to 4 kg from boiler-2, what is the condition of steam generated by boiler-2?  
  Also find the related parameter of steam.  
  
  1B)          A steam boiler generates steam at the rate of 3000kg per hour at 0.5 MPa and 230°C and  
  is fed with coal at the rate of 1500 kg/hr which has a calorific value of 24 MJ/kg. The  
  water is fed to the boiler at a temperature 25°C. If the boiler performance is to be    (3)  
  enhanced by 10% by preheating feed water by 5oC, what will be the percentage  
  reduction in coal consumption?  
  
  1C)          Explain the devices used to recover the waste exhaust gas heat coming out from the  
  steam boiler furnace for preheating of air and feed water.                                 (3)  
  
  2A)          The machine and motor shafts are placed at a centre distance of 5 m. The motor drives  
  the machine shaft using a flat belt drive system in which the machine shaft rotates in the  
  same direction as the motor shaft. The tight side tension in the belt is 1500 N. The speed  
  and diameter of the larger pulley are 300 rpm and 1500 mm respectively. If the speed       (4)  
  reduction ratio is 5, determine the power transmitted by the belt drive. Assume the  
  coefficient of friction between the belt and the pulley surface as 0.4.  
  
  2B)          A power transmission system makes use of gear drive system with an aim to achieve  
  maximum velocity ratio using the following gears:  
  • Gears A,B,C,D,E,F,G and H have a gear teeth of 10,20,30,40,50,80,120 and 140  
  respectively.  
  • Gears A, B, D, E and H has a circular pitch of 2 mm while the rest have a circular pitch  
  of 3 mm.                                                                                   (3)  
  What will be the maximum velocity ratio achievable from these set of gears? If all the  
  gears have the same circular pitch of 3mm, and a simple gear train is to be used, then  
  what will be percentage change in maximum achievable velocity ratio? Show the gear  
  arrangements for both cases.  
  
  2C)          What are the advantages and limitations of gear drive systems?  
  (3)

  3A)             A twin cylinder two stroke petrol engine with stroke to bore ratio of 1.2 develops 64 kW  
  at 5000 rpm. The mean effective pressure on the piston is 16 bar and mechanical  
  efficiency is 80 %. Determine (i) diameter and stroke of each cylinder (ii) brake thermal (4)  
  efficiency and (iii) indicated thermal efficiency, if the fuel consumption is 16 kg/hr and  
  the fuel is having calorific value of 44000 kJ/kg.  
  
  3B)             Explain the working of an engine fitted with a cam shaft and operating on a  
  thermodynamic cycle wherein the heat rejection and addition takes place at constant  
  volume and constant pressure respectively. Support your answer with neat sketches of        (3)  
  each stage.  
  
  3C)             Justify the following statements:  
  i) 2 stroke engines are not environment friendly.                                           (3)  
  ii) Diesel engines are bulkier than petrol engines for the same power output.  
  
  4A)             A workshop has got an order for turning two types of shafts. One with a length 1 m and  
  diameter of 50 mm and another shaft with a length of 0.5 m and diameter of 100 mm. To  
  produce these shafts, the workshop is planning to install one engine lathe at its facility. (4)  
  Suggest the workshop regarding the right lathe specifications to be considered while  
  procuring the engine lathe with proper justifications.  
  
  4B)             A hole of standard size is to be drilled to accommodate a round headed bolt. Suggest the  
  right sequence of operations that are to be carried out to accomplish the given task. Also, (3)  
  sketch and explain the suggested operations.  
  
  4C)             Explain the significance of any of the three stages involved in making of parts using  
  Additive Manufacturing.                                                                     (3)  
  
  5A)             Explain the role of the following in casting process.  
  i) Pattern  
  ii) Core                                                                                    (4)  
  iii) Sprue pins  
  iv) Vent holes  
  
  5B)             Sketch and explain the welding process wherein two steel plates are to be joined with  
  the use of filler material and employing a non-consumable electrode.                        (3)  
  
  5C)             What are the different components that make an automated system? Explain using a  
  block diagram.                                                                              (3)
